subject: Data to model performance feedback loop
text:

Given [COMPANY]'s operations in the IDV space, I thought you might be solving for model accuracy in similar high-stakes situations?

In case Encord is new to you - we support over 200 AI teams accelerate the annotation to model eval feedback loop. They typically leverage our workflow orchestrator for annotation (auto-labeling, consensus, and human QC/QA) which is integrated with our data and label validation capabilities. We've also built out functionalities around data lineage tracking and secure deployment for teams in regulated environments. 

How are you thinking about model performance feedback loop at [COMPANY]? I'm flexible Tuesday to Thursday if you're open to a chat.

subject: Deepfake Detection Accuracy
text:

prediction accuracy for deepfake detection models. GetReal came to mind
